decorated module flattens only active groups in source order
short declaration storage preserves active prefix

root test marker excludes a bootstrap module
module name may not be a form
ordinary declaration must be a form even after a selected declaration
unknown predicate after a module exclusion is still an error
pragma directive must be a form
